column1: # FIXTURE QUEUE — NOT the farm's queue. reports/STANDING-JOBS.tsv is the farm's own governance
# (DESIGN-STATION.md §1b: farm-only, never shipped), so a clone has no queue to point at. This
# file exists only so selftest_sandbox F4b/F4c have a real file to refuse a write to when the
# farm's queue is absent: the kernel refuses the append and this file must come out BYTE-
# IDENTICAL (its sha256 is quoted before and after). Its rows are illustrative, never read.
# Same header as the real queue so the shape a lane would target is recognisable.

column3: fixture job — a clone's stand-in for the farm queue
